SELECT first_name , last_name FROM Students WHERE major_id NOT IN (SELECT major_id FROM Majors ORDER BY student_count DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT T1.venue FROM Debates AS T1 JOIN Audience AS T2 ON T1.debate_id = T2.debate_id ORDER BY T2.audience_size ASC
SELECT count(*) , sum(total_billed) FROM Invoices WHERE billing_state = "CA"
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.state) FROM College_Students AS T1 JOIN Positions AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.position_name = "mid" AND T2.position_name != "goalie"
SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name , T1.last_name FROM Staff AS T1 JOIN Staff_Problems AS T2 ON T1.staff_id = T2.staff_id WHERE T2.problem_id = 1
SELECT campus_name FROM Campuses WHERE city IN ('Northridge' , 'Los Angeles' , 'San Francisco' , 'San Francisco')
SELECT T1.manufacturer_name , AVG(T2.price) FROM Products AS T1 JOIN Product_Prices AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T1.manufacturer_name
SELECT enrollment_date , completion_date FROM Students
SELECT T1.start_date ,  T1.end_date FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Locations AS T2 ON T1.location_id  =  T2.location_id WHERE T1.document_name  =  "Robin CV"
SELECT first_name , last_name , salary FROM Employees WHERE commission IS NULL
SELECT T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Majors AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.major_id = 50
SELECT T1.first_name , T1.last_name FROM Artists AS T1 JOIN Songs AS T2 ON T1.artist_id = T2.artist_id WHERE T2.song_title = "Badlands"
SELECT T1.name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Friends AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
SELECT T1.customer_id ,  T1.first_name FROM Customers AS T1 WHERE T1.credit_card_number IS NULL
SELECT date_joined FROM Customers WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 10 AND 20
SELECT document_id FROM Documents WHERE budget_description = 'Government'
SELECT T1.first_name , T1.last_name FROM Teachers AS T1 JOIN Classes AS T2 ON T1.teacher_id = T2.teacher_id GROUP BY T1.teacher_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.driver_id ,  T2.nationality FROM Drivers AS T1 JOIN Race_Results AS T2 ON T1.driver_id  =  T2.driver_id WHERE T2.laptime  >  100000
SELECT T1.part_name , COUNT(*) FROM Parts AS T1 JOIN Assets AS T2 ON T1.part_id = T2.part_id GROUP BY T1.part_id
SELECT T1.name FROM film_studios AS T1 JOIN films AS T2 ON T1.studio_id = T2.studio_id GROUP BY T1.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.college) FROM Players AS T1 JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id WHERE T2.team_name = 'Columbus Crew'
SELECT T1.mountain_id ,  T1.name FROM Mountains AS T1 JOIN Mountain_Photos AS T2 ON T1.mountain_id  =  T2.mountain_id GROUP BY T1.mountain_id HAVING COUNT(*)  >=  2
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Students WHERE allergy = "cat"
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM People WHERE language != 'English'
SELECT air_date FROM Episodes WHERE title = "A Love of a Lifetime"
SELECT allergy_type , COUNT(*) FROM Student_Allergies GROUP BY allergy_type
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Budget_Codes
SELECT phone_number FROM Customers WHERE first_name = "Nancy" AND last_name = "Edwards"
SELECT T1.name FROM Swimmers AS T1 JOIN Swim_Records AS T2 ON T1.swimmer_id = T2.swimmer_id GROUP BY T1.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
